reason: An out-of-repo DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on agent tool-call governance: it denies selected credential and secret flows, redacts outputs and telemetry, prompts on risky configuration changes, and records audit decisions. The README explicitly documents pattern-based detection and in-process bypass limitations.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的数据防泄漏插件，可拦截部分凭据和秘密相关工具调用、清理结果与遥测内容，并记录决策审计信息。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness data-loss-prevention plugin that intercepts selected credential and secret-related tool calls, redacts results and telemetry, and records audit decisions.

capabilities: Intercepts agent tool calls and denies credential-file or secret-bearing requests
Redacts detected secrets from tool results, session logs, and exported telemetry
Prompts before behavior-changing file writes or attempts to suppress approval
Strips invisible instruction characters and terminal control sequences from selected outputs
Neutralizes remote markdown images in assistant output
Writes keyed-hash audit records for denials, redactions, rewrites, and prompts
